text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Okay, here's mine... Your turn, Fine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm going to... Oh, I know! Okay,
I'll go with
this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I hear lively voices coming from one of
the
classrooms as I'm walking through
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You sound like you're having fun. Are
you playing
a game?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We're drawing pictures of things
that start
with the letters of the
alphabet, like this...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. So that's "ramen," right? Well it's
a nice
picture, but I already did one for
"R"! Remember
my rabbit?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh, whoops! Well, I guess I'm out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fine sure loves ramen.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
She really does! Between that and her
being super
friendly, it really makes you
forget she's from an
aristocratic family.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You think so? But isn't everyone
enchanted by a good bowl of ramen? All
those noodles tangled
up in the shop's
special broth, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Is there anything besides ramen
that
you're really into?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Um, let's see... Yeah, actually! I've been
getting
into photography lately!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: It's so fun to whip your phone out, go tap tap ☆ and just casually capture a nice little memory. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Casually? Was it difficult to take
pictures back
home?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Weeell, as a matter of fact, it was. But
back then,
the way we did things felt
totally normal to me.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for keeping you all waiting.
I've come in my Tracen Academy
uniform, so shall we take
some
commemorative photos?

text_block_list.name: Head Maid
text_block_list.text:
This way, Your Highness. We'll take the
pictures
just as soon as we've applied
your makeup. Lights!
Camera! Security!

text_block_list.name: Attendant
text_block_list.text:
Yes, right here! The reflector is in
position!

text_block_list.name: Security
text_block_list.text:
Eagle Squad! Assume photography
positions and
provide security from
above!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
We need to get some with me in my
tracksuit as well. I'd like everybody to
get a glimpse of the
sort of culture I'll
be experiencing.

text_block_list.name: Head Maid
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll fetch the shoes we made to fit
Your
Highness's feet.

text_block_list.name: Security
text_block_list.text:
Hound Squad, do you copy? Assume diamond
formation with Her Highness at
the center! Run
alongside the camera
crew!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for the inconvenience. Thank
you very
much for your service.

text_block_list.name: Security
text_block_list.text: Our pleasure!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...You know, that kind of thing?
Everyone had to
work quite hard.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That was beyond anything I could ever
imagine...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and it's so fun being able to show
everyone
the pictures you've taken right
away. Actually,
just recently...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a sec. Fine! I'm looking at your

Umastagram followers and... is this?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
A flood of likes from celebrities I've
seen
on TV...
on a picture of veggie-loaded
ramen...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding-dong, ding-dong ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's the school bell. Agh, I have to
clean
the blackboard!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like I've been treated to a
glimpse of a
completely different world.
